Incorrect/loose earth connection between cable harness and product
Flow or return NTC defective (loose connection)
Arc/black discharge via ignition cable, ignition plug or ignition electrode causing interference

checks.step: Check flow temperature sensor is correctly thermally connected (clipped to pipe)
Check cable harness and earthing of product
Ensure sufficient purging/bleeding of heating system has been carried out
Inspect ignition cable, plug and electrode for arcing/black discharge marks

reset: Allow the boiler to cool, then press the reset button on the control panel to restart. Investigate and correct the overheat cause (circulation/air/earthing) before repeated resets.

Water pressure sensor defective
Cable to pump or water pressure sensor loose/not connected/defective

checks.step: Check system pressure gauge/display reading
checks.expected: 1.0-2.0 bar cold fill pressure (check manual for exact model spec)

checks.step: Check plug and cable to water pressure sensor and heating pump
Inspect for visible leaks at radiators, pipework, pump, and valves
Activate and purge using check programme P.00 after repressurising
checks.expected: System purges without further pressure drop

reset: Top up system pressure to the correct cold-fill level using the filling loop, then press the reset button on the control panel. If pressure repeatedly drops, investigate for a system leak before resetting again.

Strainer in hydraulic block blocked
Plug/cable to heating pump or water pressure sensor faulty

Check for air in the heating circuit and bleed as required
Verify flow and return NTC sensors are not inverted
checks.expected: Flow sensor on flow pipe, return sensor on return pipe

checks.step: Inspect strainer in hydraulic block for blockage
Confirm heating pump circulation is adequate (check pump speed/parameters D.19, D.14)
checks.expected: Sufficient flow rate per pump curve

checks.step: Run check programme P.00 to purge and verify

reset: Press the reset button on the control panel after correcting circulation/sensor issue. Activate check programme P.00 to purge before returning to normal operation.

source.manual: ecoTEC pro Installation and maintenance instructions (VUW ..6/5-3), doc 0020244995_05

reset: Press the reset button on the control panel after resolving the circulation fault. Run check programme P.00 to verify before leaving the system.

Insufficient water in heating circuit / internal air vent not functioning
Heating pump fault
Faulty plug/safety cut-out plug/cable harness

checks.step: Inspect flue route for blockage, correct length/number of bends, and terminal position relative to wind effects
checks.expected: Clear, within Vaillant design length/bend limits

checks.step: Check plug, safety cut-out plug and cable harness to heating pump
Check internal air vent functions correctly
Confirm sufficient water in heating circuit and adequate pump circulation
Run check programme P.00 before returning to service
checks.expected: Flue gas temperature within normal range

reset: Press the reset button on the control panel once the flue blockage/circulation fault is corrected. Do not repeatedly reset without investigating the flue route — this is a combustion safety-critical fault.

source.manual: ecoTEC pro Installation and maintenance instructions (VUW ..6/5-3), doc 0020244995_05

series: ecoTEC Plus / ecoTEC Pro / ecoTEC Exclusive (shared fault-code architecture, 2010-present combi/system/regular)

causes.cause: Monitoring/ionisation electrode reports an incorrect flame signal
Moisture on the electronics
Electronics (flame monitor) defective
Gas solenoid valve leaking internally

checks.step: Check gas pressure at the upper test opening
checks.expected: Within permissible range per data badge (natural gas 13-23 mbar; LPG 23-43 mbar)

checks.step: Inspect monitoring/ionisation electrode condition and position
checks.expected: Clean, correctly positioned, no carbon deposit

checks.step: Check for moisture ingress on PCB/electronics box
Gas-tightness test the gas solenoid valve for internal leakage
Check PCB flame detection circuit

reset: Press the reset button on the control panel after confirming no real flame simulation cause. Do not reset repeatedly without investigating the ionisation electrode and gas valve — this is a gas safety-critical fault (risk of undetected flame).

series: ecoTEC Plus / ecoTEC Pro / ecoTEC Exclusive (shared fault-code architecture, 2010-present combi/system/regular)
meaning: Start-up failure: Ignition unsuccessful (failure during start-up/first ignition attempt)

causes.cause: Gas flow pressure too low or gas pressure monitor/thermal cut-out triggered
Air in gas supply (e.g. after new installation, meter work, or LPG tank changeover)
Ignition system fault: ignition transformer, ignition cable, ignition plug or ignition electrode defective
Ionisation current interrupted (cable/electrode) or incorrect earthing of product
Condensate duct blocked
Incorrect gas restrictor/injector or incorrect spare-part gas valve fitted
Gas meter defective

checks.step: Check gas stopcock is fully open
Measure gas flow (inlet working) pressure at the test point with boiler firing on check programme P.01
Purge air from the gas line if recently worked on
checks.expected: Clean gas at test point, no air

checks.step: Inspect ignition transformer, ignition cable, ignition plug and ignition electrode for damage/wear
checks.expected: No cracking, correct electrode gap (check manual)

checks.step: Check ionisation/monitoring electrode cable and connection for continuity
Check condensate duct/trap for blockage
Verify correct gas restrictor/injector fitted for gas type and that any replacement gas valve is the correct part
checks.expected: Matches Vaillant spec for gas type

checks.step: Check product earthing

reset: Press the reset button on the control panel to retry ignition. If the boiler repeatedly fails to ignite, do not keep resetting — investigate gas supply pressure and ignition components; this is a gas safety-critical fault.
